text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Okay, so now you just start typing, and
it'll
suggest some words for you...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ooh, I see them! Right there at the top.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's them. It'll suggest words you use a
lot,
even if you only type in the first
letter.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Then all you have to do is press the
word you
want once it shows up.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hoho. Sooo... if I just press this here,
then... I did
it!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
They say the technology of today is
outdated
tomorrow. It's incredible how
fast things change.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I heard this phrase on TV, but it's stuck
with me.
They said it's important to think
of the ordinary
as if it's extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If we never let ourselves get content, it
means
we'll always strive for
improvement.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Never take things for granted, and
always strive for improvement... That
sounds like a good way
to always shake
things up.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I wish I could update my training the way
you
update a phone. Then I could...
improve...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Lightning just struck. I'm going to head
to the
track for a minute.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
All righty!
That's a wrap on turf training!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now to pop over for a quick lap on ol'

reliable—the dirt track!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I get it! You're making your training
more
efficient by switching up the
exercises you do!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll try it too! First up,
one quick
lap on my
usual!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears Wonder Acute had a stroke of 
inspiration. From that day forward, she
tackles
her training with increased
efficacy.
